role: Records every declined bot action immutably, in a real tenant-scoped, RLS-protected ledger — closing the loop on every permission-boundary refusal that occurs across the swarm, previously audited but never persisted to a queryable ledger.
behaviorDescription: recordRefusal() persists a declined action to the proof_of_restraint table — insert-only, since restraint-store.ts provides no update or delete function at all, matching this bot's own 'immutably' requirement. Every recorded refusal unconditionally signals the swarm, since a declined action is always worth knowing about — this feeds the same intent as the AppSpec's public transparency endpoint (GET /api/safety/restraint-ledger), even though that HTTP endpoint itself is not built here. listRefusals() reads back a tenant's restraint history, read-only.
hardStops: Never provides any way to alter or delete a recorded refusal — insert-only, matching 'immutably' in this bot's own role
Never fabricates a Veridact receipt — receipt_id is a nullable placeholder until @features/veridact is actually built
Never silently skips signaling the swarm on a recorded refusal — every declined action is unconditionally surfaced
